label: UniFi Cloud Gateway Max
description: Ubiquiti UCG-Max - compact fanless 2.5G cloud gateway with NVR: 5x 2.5GbE RJ45 (1 WAN + 4 LAN), no SFP cages.
notes: Power: none of these copper ports accepts PoE. Vendor page https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ucg-max (HTTP 200, 668,564 B, read 2026-11-19, server-rendered tech-spec table) says "Power Method = USB type C (5V DC/5A)"; a box fed from mains, a USB-C supply or a DC jack has no PoE-PD front end, so WAN / Port 1 / Port 2 / Port 3 / Port 4 now declare poeIn: false. Without that declaration the engine's isPoePd() match on "unifi" gave each silent copper port a 12.95 W 802.3af draw - the defect PR #2118 and PR #2121 fixed across the UXG family (refs #130).
